messages:
Priya (PM): FYI PilgrimRetail legal signed variant B. They want a private deployment (VPC) in us-west, dedicated capacity ~200 rps, and a GA target in mid-Aug. Need alignment on scope + delivery date. @Alex @Mateo
Alex (Eng): quick q — what model families are they using in pilot? size, kv-cache needs, and are they ok with int8 quant?
Mateo (CS): Pilot is on hosted with gpt-3.5-open weights (custom prompt stack). Using chat + embeddings. Latency avg ~180ms, p95 ~320ms under test load. They have strict data residency/KMS requirements.
Jordan (SE): Also flagged: SOC2 + customer wants HSM-backed KMS + audit logs. Will need that in private package.
Priya (PM): Trade-offs we discussed w/ customer: can ship private control plane + KMS first, push advanced autoscaling policies & long-term dashboarding to Q4. They want predictable throughput before we enable canary.
Casey (ProdOps): Add to roadmap milestone tracker: PilgrimRetail-private-uswest. This will be a sales-assisted enterprise deal — revenue basis for Q3 OKR?
Alex (Eng): Rough estimate: infra plumbing & VPC plumbing + KMS integration: 4 weeks. Dedicated runtime + perf tuning (batching/kv cache): 3-4 weeks. + 1 week rollout/canary. So ~8-9 weeks total.
Priya (PM): OK that pushes GA out. They asked for Aug 12 earlier; with these estimates we should propose Aug 30. Can we shorten any tasks?
Alex (Eng): We can parallelize control plane work and runtime tuning. If we de-scope noncritical features (no per-token cost analytics in first cut) we can hit ~7 weeks. Still likely late Aug.
Mateo (CS): Risk note: quantizing to int8 improved cost but degraded their top-k rerank accuracy by ~3% in our evals. Customer will accept small quality deltas?
Jordan (SE): Fallback plan: if dedicated variant underperforms, route traffic to hosted with strict ACLs. Need automated routing policy in rollout.
Priya (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal (please vote): 1) Sustained 150 rps with <250ms p95 for chat at target model 2) KMS/HSM integration + audit logs 3) Canary for 2 weeks with gradual ramp 4) Rollback policy to hosted route.
Alex (Eng): +1. I'll add a minimal autoscaling policy snippet for the infra team.
Alex (Eng): ```yaml
autoscale:
  min_instances: 2
  max_instances: 10
  target_rps: 200
  cooldown_sec: 45
```
Casey (ProdOps): We'll tag OKR: "Enterprise delivery — secure private deployment" and mark dependency on eng-runtime and infra.
Priya (PM): Action items: Alex — detailed T-shirt estimates by EOD Thu, Jordan — KMS/HSM requirements doc by Fri, Mateo — confirm pilot perf delta acceptance with customer. I'll draft the proposed Aug 30 delivery and negotiate scope with the customer.
Mateo (CS): I already pinged customer; they prefer earlier but will accept Aug 30 if we commit to the rollback and a 2-week canary.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window placeholder created: `deploy:pilgrim-priv-usw-2026-08-25 -> 2026-09-08`
Priya (PM): cool. if no objections I'll update the roadmap and send the date to the account team after estimates come in. :thumbsup:
Alex (Eng): no objections from eng. will break down tasks in the ticket.
Jordan (SE): I'll coordinate security review.
Casey (ProdOps): Marking this as high priority for Q3 delivery planning.
Priya (PM): thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for PilgrimRetail private delivery details.
